title: Dimensions Expansion
description: New dimensions, new mobs from other dimensions, and even a guardian dimension
body:
This is a mode with expanded space-time and especially dimensions.

If you're tired of fighting zombies, ender dragons and ghasts, why not go to a completely new dimension?

For example, have you already looked at the empire that bees have inside the hive?

Or the Warden dimension?

Did you want to see Mars, or go to a completely reversed dimension?

Here you can do it ! ! !

New mobs can cause you real problems like scorpions from another dimension or a new boss in the red palace, doesn't it look like any other boss to you?!

And definitely when you're in the bee dimension, don't hit the bee :-D![Dávajte bacha na včeli](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4d3d5a4db30587495b7178e4642b1d39c9c055ff.jpeg)
